view: PA erect frontal chest radiograph (probable PA; upright, gastric bubble present). Adequate inspiration, minimal rotation, adequate penetration.
technical_quality: Adequate. Good inspiration (about 9-10 posterior ribs), no significant rotation (clavicular heads roughly equidistant from spinous processes), acceptable penetration with vertebral bodies faintly visible through the cardiac shadow. Breast shadows overlie both lower zones. A black rectangular bar along the left image edge is a processing/collimation artifact.

devices.type: External film marker: 'L' side marker with adjacent round radiopaque marker
devices.location: Upper right corner of image, projected over the patient's left shoulder soft tissue, outside the thorax

devices.type: Image processing / collimation artifact (black rectangular bar)
devices.location: Left image edge, upper third (outside the patient)

abnormalities.finding: Mild cardiomegaly: cardiothoracic ratio approximately 0.55-0.57, with a rounded left ventricular contour displaced laterally; no pulmonary venous congestion or interstitial edema

description_zh: 胸部正面立位攝影，吸氣深度足夠，無明顯旋轉，穿透度適中。心臟輪廓略呈擴大，心胸比約0.55–0.57，左心緣圓鈍並向外側偏移；氣管及縱膈居中，主動脈弓不明顯，肺門血管無明顯增粗。兩側肺野清晰，無實質化、結節或肋膜積液，兩側肋膈角銳利；兩側下肺野可見乳房軟組織陰影重疊。骨骼結構未見明顯異常；影像右上角見L側標記及圓形標記物，影像左緣黑色邊框為處理偽影，未見任何管路或治療裝置。
